verdict.rationale: The IRS is a government tax-filing and payments service, not an AI agent or assistant host, so acting as an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any such capability. Its machine channels (MeF XML, IRIS A2A) are credentialed filing intakes, not MCP tool consumption.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
